name: cannon-alerts-mobs
description: D-149: a Hand Cannon shot is heard 60 m around (NoiseRules.CannonShotRadius). A Greydwarf 25 m to the side starts hunting the player, a Greydwarf Brute 85 m to the other side does not hear it. The player is in ghost mode, so the mobs react to the noise, not to seeing the player; both stand off the line of fire. Ghost mode goes on AFTER cannonStock: that function starts with GunPowdered.arena, whose cleanup switches ghost off (a18full1/2: the Greydwarf saw the player, already had a target, the shot alerted 0).

steps.name: GunPowdered.labHostile
steps.label: creatures can be alerted, as in a real game (user 2026-11-23: the lab's CreaturesHostile off had kept every Alert() from sticking; the lab turns it off again between tests)

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseLast
steps.regex: hand cannon shot at .*radius 60 m, alerted [1-9]
steps.label: the shot alerts mobs within 60 m
